♏ The Scorpio Cloth. OFFENSE

Signature Technique

@UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Scarlet Needle]

Cloth Passive — Fifteen Needles

Track Scarlet Needles separately for each creature; they reset when you rest or when the encounter ends. When you hit a creature with an unarmed Strike, you can add a needle to it as a free action, to a maximum of 15.

At 5 needles the creature is enfeebled 1. At 10 it is blinded. At 14 it is stunned 2 and its Strikes lose the benefit of their runes.

Tracking note: the resource on your sheet counts needles on your current target, and the toggles below flag which threshold is live. Needles on several creatures at once have to be tracked by hand — the system has no per-target counter.

Ascendant Boon — Antares [OFFENSE]

Needles land on any attack you make against a creature, whether it hits or misses. Each needle on a creature deals 1d6 persistent bleed damage, stacking, to a maximum of 10 needles' worth.

At 8 needles, the creature must attempt a Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC or die. This is an incapacitation effect.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Ascendant (Scorpio)]

Zenith Boon — Antares (Zenith) [OFFENSE]

As the Ascendant Boon, but the death effect triggers at 5 needles, and your allies' hits also apply needles — you orchestrate the swarm.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Zenith (Scorpio)]

11th-Level Cloth Ability — Antares
